title: GRAHAM BREAD
instructions: --Put one cup of scalded and cooled milk, one cup of water, two cups of flour and one-half yeast cake dissolved in one cup of lukewarm water into a bowl and let rise over night. In the morning add a level teaspoon of salt, two
rounding cups of graham flour and one-half cup sugar. Beat well, put into two pans and let rise until light and bake one hour.
